cues.text: A vast plain of tall, golden grass stretches towards jagged, leaning mountains under a bright blue sky.
In the foreground, a large, bizarre bird sits on an outcrop. A thin crest loops back over its head, and a massive, dark beak curves downwards.
Its breast is white, with green and yellow feathers. In the distance, a herd of dark animals grazes.
A bright streak of light tears across the clouds.
The colony ship's landing craft descends towards the distant mountains, trailing a long tail of white fire.

beats.note: A vast golden grassland with tall, leaning, jagged mountains in the distance.
In the right foreground, a large alien bird sits on a rock. It has a huge downward-curving beak, a loop crest on its head, and white, green, and yellow feathers.
A herd of dark grazing animals is visible in the middle distance.
A streak of light appears in the sky on the left, moving right and downwards.
The streak of light crosses the sky above the plain.
The light continues to descend towards the mountains.
The image begins to fade to black.
